messages:
deploy-bot: Scheduled release wave 'micro-window-42' starts in 30m — components: API v2.3.0, runtime v3.1.5, console v1.9.3, router v2.8. Rolling canary: 5% -> 25% -> 100%. Pin note: runtime v3.1.5 requires api >= v2.3.0.
sam: Quick question — do we need to pin the router to avoid header-split mismatch? I can hold router until runtime canary is green.
lia: Prefer sequence: runtime, api, router, console. runtime has KV eviction tweak that can cause 502s on warmup. Keep canary low for 15m.
eugene: Can we run a small traffic shadow to runtime before routing? If canary passes we do 5% -> 25% after 10m.
marie: Release notes updated: https://go/internal/release/micro-window-42 — rollback criteria: >3% 5xx, p95 latency regressed by >200ms for 5m, or errors in structured logs 'kv_evict_fail'.
rahul: I'll add a temporary latency SLO monitor and a manual hold channel. If p95 > 350ms we hit hold and rollback.
sam: Command I plan to run (dry):
```
/deploy start micro-window-42 --sequence runtime,api,router,console --canary 5 --watch 15m
```
lia: I approve the sequence. Also add this flag for runtime to disable async-evict on canary: `RUNTIME_EVICT_ASYNC=false`.
eugene: +1. Plan for quick rollback steps in case router header split fails: router pin back to v2.7.9 and re-route to edge-legacy.
marie: Note: console change is purely UI; safe to deploy last. Ensure release note callout to CS.
ops-bot: metric-alert: api-prod error-rate baseline 0.2% — watching.
deploy-bot: Canary started (5%). Runtime canary hosts: runtime-az1-7, runtime-az2-3. Monitoring: dashboard/r/micro-window-42.
sam: Seeing warmup logs — a couple of transient 502s, not scary. Lia, are the eviction flags in place?
lia: Yes deployed to canary with `RUNTIME_EVICT_ASYNC=false`. I'm watching KV hit ratio.
eugene: After 10m if no >0.5% 5xx we move to 25%.
rahul: I've wired a slack alert to /alerts/release-hold if p95 spikes > 350ms.
sam: ok proceeding to 25% in 2m. tagging @marie for release note mention :thumbsup: 
marie: ack. I'll ping CS and update the status doc.
ops-bot: metric-update: p95 latency runtime canary 290ms -> stable baseline 240ms. No critical errors.
deploy-bot: Canary at 25% complete, proceeding to ramp to 100% in staged steps. If anyone needs to hold, post in-thread now.
lia: Holding off router until runtime hits stable 100% for 10m.
sam: Roger. We'll not promote router until runtime stable window completes.
marie: PR for console rollout merged. Final notes published.
rahul: All good on my end. If we hit hold I will trigger rollback via `/deploy rollback micro-window-42 --target runtime`.
sam: Thanks team — tagging release as successful once router goes up. :tada:
